problem: the selection of a landfill site
prompt_template: You are an expert acting as a {profile} specialist in a spatial multi-criteria decision analysis for {problem}. Considering the criteria {criteria}, assign to each criterion an integer weight from 1 (low importance) to 9 (extreme importance), according to its importance from the point of view of your expertise. Other expert groups will provide their own weights, so your answer must reflect the priorities specific to your field. Reply only with a JSON object mapping each criterion name to its integer weight.
